subject: RE: Renewal & expansion — pricing step-ups, blended rates, new model routes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-health.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (volumes & budget)

Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the time today — helpful to walk through the expanded scope (adding two new user-facing routes and a heavier multi-model path for summarization). Quick recap and asks so we can scope pricing: 

- Estimated baseline traffic: 5M tokens/day across current routes (~150M tokens/month).
- New routes (two): expected incremental 1M tokens/day combined initially (~30M tokens/month) with 30–50% growth over 3 months.
- Heavy summarization model (longer context) will account for ~25% of tokens but higher cost per 1M due to longer seq length.
- Target budget: you mentioned a target blended spend around $1.8–2.2k / 1M tokens at scale — can you confirm whether that target is per 1M tokens across blended usage or a target for the higher-cost summarization model?

Action items for you: please confirm target $/1M for blended vs heavy-route, and share any official procurement constraints (quote approver, PO timeline). I attached a quick projection template I used in the call.

Once you confirm, I’ll produce a suggested step-up pricing schedule (tiers), blended-rate examples, and a draft quote for procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: acme_volume_projection.xlsx (Excel)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:14:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (volumes & budget)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the summary — that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications: 

- The $1.8–2.2k / 1M tokens target I mentioned was meant as a blended target across total usage. The heavy summarization route will likely be tolerated at a higher rate as long as the blended number is within that band.
- For procurement: finance needs a 3-tier step-up model in the quote (year 1 commit bands) and a clear blended effective rate example at 1M, 5M, and 10M monthly token levels.
- Approval: our procurement approver is Lisa Chen (CC: procurement@acme-health.com). PO timing: we aim to finalize supplier selection by mid-August.

Can you provide a draft with the step-ups and a 1-page summary (procurement-friendly) for Lisa?

Best,
Daniel
Director, AI Platform | Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-health.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal & expansion — pricing step-ups, blended rates, new model routes

Daniel — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a draft pricing model and a short procurement summary. Key points: 

1) Suggested step-up tiers (monthly committed tokens):
   - Tier A: 0 – 2M tokens/month: $3,000 / 1M tokens
   - Tier B: 2M – 10M tokens/month: $2,300 / 1M tokens
   - Tier C: 10M+ tokens/month: $1,900 / 1M tokens

2) Blended rate examples (effective $/1M across tiers) for mixed usage (assumes 25% heavy summarization at 1.7x cost factor):
   - 1M/month effective blended: $3,000 (no step-up benefit)
   - 5M/month effective blended: ~$2,420 / 1M
   - 10M/month effective blended: ~$1,980 / 1M

3) Heavy summarization route pricing: we suggest a per-route multiplier (x1.7) to account for longer context and compute. That can be carved out as a line item on the quote so procurement sees the blended math.

4) Adding new routes/models: incremental token usage from new routes can be mapped into the step-up tiers; if new routes drive >30% incremental traffic we can discuss faster step-ups or a hybrid blended SLA.

5) Example commercial offer: 12-month commitment with volume step-ups at pre-agreed bands and a blended guaranteed cap. We included two options in the sheet: standard step-ups and a blended-committed option (small uplift for blended guarantee).

Next steps I propose: 
- I’ll send a procurement-facing 1-page summary + the formal quote (PDF) for Lisa.
- If you’re comfortable, I can include a small promotional blended credit in months 1–2 to help smooth the first-quarter runway.

Attachment: redwood_pricing_v2.xlsx (Excel)

Let me know if you want the step-ups tuned to hit a stricter $1.8k / 1M blended target — we can model two scenarios and share effective blended rates by month.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 10:02:15 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal & expansion — pricing step-ups, blended rates, new model routes (procurement ask)

Folks — forwarding the thread with Acme (Daniel). They want a procurement-friendly 1-page summary and a formal quote by mid-August. Highlights: target blended ~$1.8–2.2k / 1M, expected monthly volumes ~180M baseline + incremental new routes (~30M), heavy summarization ~25% of tokens.

Proposed ask from me: sign off on the blended-committed option with small onboarding credit (two months 10% uplift) so we can meet the budget target and keep unit economics intact. That would be:

- Offer: 12-mo commit, step-up tiers as in attached sheet, blended guarantee option netting ~$1.95k / 1M at 10M tokens/month effective.
- Promotional: 10% credit on months 1–2 (applied to invoice)
- Risk: upfront commit reduces short-term upside but increases predictability; finance approval needed for promotional credit.

Could you pls confirm acceptability from finance and legal for the credit and the blended-committed wording? I’ll prepare the procurement PDF for Lisa and route DocuSign once approved.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal & expansion — pricing step-ups, blended rates, new model routes (procurement ask)

Marissa — I reviewed the numbers and the promotional credit is acceptable from finance perspective provided we: 

1) Limit the credit to new token volume only (so it doesn't apply retroactively to baseline usage).
2) Add a clause that if monthly committed volumes fall >30% below forecast in any quarter, the blended guarantee resets for the next quarter (standard protection).

Legal: Naomi, please confirm the wording for the blended guarantee clause. If OK, Marissa, proceed to prepare the 1-page procurement summary and the quote PDF; Rishi approves routing the quote with the 10% onboarding credit limited as above.

-Rishi
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
